reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (South Dakota, focus year 2021)

    Question: "Is it specified on what basis it is unlawful to evict a tenant under state/territory law?"
    We answer this as: Does applicable state law specify at least one "basis" (reason) on which eviction is unlawful?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(south_dakota).
focus_year(2021).

% Helper predicate summarizing the scenario in logic form.
scenario_statement :-
    state(south_dakota),
    focus_year(2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  SD Codified Laws  20-13-20 (2021)
  "Unfair or discriminatory housing practices ..."
  Protected bases: race, color, creed, religion, sex, ancestry, disability,
                   familial status, national origin.
*/
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(race).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(color).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(creed).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(religion).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(sex).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(ancestry).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(disability).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(familial_status).
statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(national_origin).

/*
  We encode that discrimination in "terms, conditions, or privileges" of rental/lease
  is an unlawful housing practice. Eviction/termination is treated as a "term/condition/privilege"
  affecting continued occupancy.
*/
statute_sd_20_13_20_eviction_prohibited_basis(basis(discrimination, ProtectedBasis)) :-
    statute_sd_20_13_20_protected_basis(ProtectedBasis).

/*
  SD Codified Laws  43-32-18.1 (2021)
  "Eviction of tenant--Limitations."
  - Lease may not authorize eviction of a tenant who calls/seeks assistance from law enforcement
    or other emergency responders because of alleged:
      domestic abuse, unlawful sexual behavior, stalking.
  - Nothing authorizes eviction solely because tenant/household member is the victim of alleged:
      domestic abuse, unlawful sexual behavior, stalking.
*/
statute_sd_43_32_18_1_incident_type(domestic_abuse).
statute_sd_43_32_18_1_incident_type(unlawful_sexual_behavior).
statute_sd_43_32_18_1_incident_type(stalking).

statute_sd_43_32_18_1_eviction_prohibited_basis(basis(seeks_emergency_assistance, IncidentType)) :-
    statute_sd_43_32_18_1_incident_type(IncidentType).

statute_sd_43_32_18_1_eviction_prohibited_basis(basis(victim_status_only, IncidentType)) :-
    statute_sd_43_32_18_1_incident_type(IncidentType).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: aggregate whether the law specifies any unlawful eviction basis
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Under the provided statutes, these are the specified bases making eviction unlawful.
unlawful_eviction_basis(Basis) :-
    statute_sd_20_13_20_eviction_prohibited_basis(Basis).
unlawful_eviction_basis(Basis) :-
    statute_sd_43_32_18_1_eviction_prohibited_basis(Basis).

% The question is "is it specified on what basis it is unlawful to evict?"
% We say "yes" if at least one such basis exists in the applicable law set.
specified_unlawful_eviction_basis_in_applicable_law :-
    scenario_statement,
    unlawful_eviction_basis(_).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (must be deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    specified_unlawful_eviction_basis_in_applicable_law,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint + required initialization
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified on what basis it is unlawful to evict a tenant under state/territory law?
